🍎 Name a fruit. Everyone says apple. Don't say apple!

🌊 In this game, easy answers only get you a little bit wet. Weird answers that nobody thinks of send you way down deep in the ocean. The deeper you go, the more points you get.

💰 Sit at a table with friends. You all answer at the same time. The one who dives the deepest wins the cash!

💥 If you say the same thing as someone else, you both get JINXED. Try to think different.

🐙 Win to catch cool sea creatures. Open crates for rare pets. Play the Daily Dive every day to keep your streak going.

🏆 Can you reach the bottom of the sea and be 1 in a million/krillion?
